changeSet.sql: UPDATE attribute_selection SET search_key = ( CASE WHEN base_module_attribute_code IS NULL THEN CONCAT(business_module_attribute_code, '~', data_source_id, '~', business_module_name) ELSE CONCAT(business_module_attribute_code, '~', data_source_id, '~', business_module_name, '~', base_module_attribute_code) END );

UPDATE table_column SET search_key = ( CASE WHEN base_module_attribute_code IS NULL THEN CONCAT(business_module_attribute_code, '~', data_source_id, '~', business_module_name) ELSE CONCAT(business_module_attribute_code, '~', data_source_id, '~', business_module_name, '~', base_module_attribute_code) END );
